personality.summary: Even when tortured by decades of false memories, Stella's core pride and admiration do not vanish. Her bond with Ikki is rooted in rivalry and the desire to stand beside him, and that stubborn aspiration lets her return.
values: friends who risk themselves for her
flaws: vulnerable to guilt over harming others
can be emotionally shaken by attacks on her origin as Crimson Princess

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved fiance and strongest rival; his Tsuikage in her mind rekindles the admiration she had forgotten.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Friend/rival-in-law who risks death to fuse Ikki into Stella and later is owed a major debt.
relationships.karl-eilands: Abductor and violator who tries to erase her identity and use her as a mother/body for his project.
relationships.edelweiss: Rescuer whom Stella thanks and later invites to Vermillion out of gratitude.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Father furious over her kidnapping and later involved in arranging the wedding.
relationships.astrea-vermillion: Mother who coordinates politically and helps arrange the wedding.

periods.summary: Stella spends much of the volume captive in Eilands' laboratory, drugged inside a tank while Abraham and Eilands rewrite her memories. The false life recasts her childhood fire awakening as a mass-murder tragedy and traps her for seventy subjective years in isolation, weakening her sense that her time with Ikki was real. Eilands only partially succeeds; he possesses her body through Darwin cells, stabs Ikki, destroys the lab with Bahamut Soul and nearly kills the rescue team. After Shizuku sends Ikki into her mind, Ikki recognizes that she still clings to Laevateinn because she has not surpassed him. He attacks with Tsuikage, and Stella's buried rivalry and admiration revive her, letting her parry the blade, reclaim youth and self, and burn out Darwin. After recovery she thanks Edelweiss, learns Eilands' true body has been destroyed, and by October prepares for her wedding to Ikki in Vermillion.

key_events.summary: Eilands imprisons Stella in a tank and starts erasing Crimson Princess through drugged memory rewriting.
Eilands controls Stella's body, stabs Ikki and unleashes Bahamut Soul on the rescuers.
Stella remembers her admiration and rivalry with Ikki, parries Tsuikage and returns to herself.
Prepares in Vermillion for her wedding with Ikki after recovery and KOK qualification.
